pancake.name: Pancake
pancake.setup: No specific warm-up, just loosen up; barefoot; fitted clothes with ankles and hips visible. Film every position from the floor, phone tilted up against a wall/object, same spot and orientation every time, good light without strong backlight, whole body in frame. Record the whole set; hold positions statically with no momentum and never trade position for range; screenshot the lowest point for pancakes and tailors pose, the average hold for the pancake lift; add angles in a protractor app; save in a dated folder. Phase 1 builder needs measurements 1-4 (narrow, natural, maximum, tailors) plus the pancake lift for Q3.

tests.name: Pancake, maximum width
tests.camera: From the side, phone on the floor tilted up against a wall/object, same spot and orientation every time, whole body in frame
tests.cue: Sit in a straddle at MAXIMUM width (as wide as you can; your deepest mix of width and lean). Reach forward with the arms, round the spine, drop the head, lead with the chest to hinge at the pelvis. Hold actively, pulling down the whole time (no passive hanging), hold 15 s (sheet text also says 30 s). Screenshot the LOWEST point. If the head reaches the floor, record the touchpoint instead of the angle. Same width every retest within a phase.

measures.label: Pancake angle (head not on the floor)

points: point on the floor line toward the feet (feet and sit bones flat)
top of the thigh / middle of the trunk (hip)
furthest point of the upper back (if past 90 deg: highest point of the upper back)

measures.label: Touchpoint reached (if head touches)
Straddle width used (record to repeat)

position.caption: Legs as wide as you can, reach forward, round the spine, drop the head, pull down actively

tests.name: Pancake, natural width
tests.camera: From the side, phone on the floor tilted up against a wall/object, same spot and orientation every time, whole body in frame
tests.cue: Sit in a straddle at NATURAL width (comfortable). Reach forward with the arms, round the spine, drop the head, lead with the chest to hinge at the pelvis. Hold actively, pulling down the whole time (no passive hanging), hold 15 s (sheet text also says 30 s). Screenshot the LOWEST point. If the head reaches the floor, record the touchpoint instead of the angle. Same width every retest within a phase.

measures.label: Pancake angle (head not on the floor)

points: point on the floor line toward the feet (feet and sit bones flat)
top of the thigh / middle of the trunk (hip)
furthest point of the upper back (if past 90 deg: highest point of the upper back)

measures.label: Touchpoint reached (if head touches)
Straddle width used (record to repeat)

position.caption: Comfortable straddle width, reach forward, round the spine, drop the head, pull down actively

tests.name: Pancake, narrow width
tests.camera: From the side, phone on the floor tilted up against a wall/object, same spot and orientation every time, whole body in frame
tests.cue: Sit in a straddle at NARROW width (a little straddle). Reach forward with the arms, round the spine, drop the head, lead with the chest to hinge at the pelvis. Hold actively, pulling down the whole time (no passive hanging), hold 15 s (sheet text also says 30 s). Screenshot the LOWEST point. If the head reaches the floor, record the touchpoint instead of the angle. Same width every retest within a phase.

measures.label: Pancake angle (head not on the floor)

points: point on the floor line toward the feet (feet and sit bones flat)
top of the thigh / middle of the trunk (hip)
furthest point of the upper back (if past 90 deg: highest point of the upper back)

measures.label: Touchpoint reached (if head touches)
Straddle width used (record to repeat)

position.caption: Small straddle, reach forward, round the spine, drop the head, pull down actively

tests.name: Standing pancake
tests.camera: From the side, phone on the floor (front view for reference)
tests.cue: Natural straddle width (measure it to repeat). Fold reaching the hands to the floor, bend the arms if you reach it. PASSIVE: no pulling or pulsing, hang with gravity. Hold 30 s.

measures.label: Standing pancake angle

points: middle of the glute (around the hip socket)
top of the head (rounded back and limited: most rounded part of the upper back)

measures.label: Straddle width used

position.caption: Natural straddle width, fold and hang passively, round the spine, drop the head

tests.name: Pancake lift
tests.camera: From the side, phone on the floor
tests.cue: Hands on the floor in front (closer = easier; choose a point you can hold 5 s), legs straight, knees locked, press the floor and lift both feet; slight forward lean if you can. Hold 5 s. Screenshot the AVERAGE hold, not the highest point. Cramping is common; leaning back is normal if your head cannot reach the floor.

measures.label: Pancake lift angle

points: top of the head (if the head is not neutral, follow the line of the back)

position.caption: Hands on the floor in front, legs straight and knees locked, press down and lift both feet, slight forward lean

tests.name: Tailors pose
tests.camera: From the front, phone on the floor
tests.cue: Hips right up against a wall, soles touching including heels. No holding the feet or pressing the thighs. Pull the knees apart and down actively. Hold 15 s (strenuous). Screenshot the lowest point. If the legs touch the floor, put the feet on a block. Check left vs right.

measures.label: Tailors pose angle (can reach 180 deg or more with feet on a block)

points: middle of the left knee joint
middle of the right knee joint

measures.label: Did both calves make full contact with the floor? (phase 1 builder Q1)
Feet on a block for this test

position.caption: Hips and back against the wall, soles together, hands off, pull knees apart and down

questions.text: Answer honestly. Press handstand = train a narrower width; contemporary dance = wider.
questions.name: Training pancake for a specific sport? (phase 1 builder Q4)

shoulder_flexion.name: Shoulder flexion
shoulder_flexion.setup: No specific warm-up, just loosen up lightly. Film every position from the floor, phone tilted slightly up against an object/wall (easy to recreate), good light, plain background, whole body in frame, fitted clothes, record the whole hold. Hold each position 3 s with no momentum, never trade position for range. Screenshot the AVERAGE position held, not the peak; measure angles in an app. Stabiliser (force couple) tests: max 2 per session, spread over the start of the next few sessions.

tests.name: Leahy stick test (Test 1)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): seat 48 cm high; phone 60 cm above the floor, 2.5 m away, side on and square to the lifting arm, same spot every retest. (Smith films from the floor, but for this seated test that looks up at the shoulder and skews the angle.)
tests.cue: Sit on a box, upright, high chest, look forward. Hold a stick at its CENTRE, palm up, in one hand. Arm locked, lift; the stick stays parallel to the floor. Elbow bends or stick twists = too far, lower and lift again. Hold 3 s. Screenshot the AVERAGE position. Both sides.

measures.label: Leahy flexion angle (vertical up = 180)

points: a point straight below the shoulder (true vertical, Smith's plumb line)

position.caption: Smith's form: arm against the line straight down from the shoulder

tests.name: Passive shoulder flexion (Test 2, lying)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): film in LANDSCAPE (you are lying down, portrait wastes the frame). From the side, phone on the floor
tests.cue: Lie on the back, knees bent, tuck the pelvis so the low back is flat (check with a hand). Lower both arms overhead at shoulder width, aim to touch the whole arm to the floor without the back lifting. Hold 3 s. Faults: back arching, arms drifting apart.

measures.label: Passive flexion angle (arm vs scapula line)

points: a point level with the shoulder, towards the hips (horizontal, Smith's line)

position.caption: Smith's form: lying, knees bent, low back flat, arms overhead

tests.name: Standing wall shoulder flexion (Test 2, perpendicular)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): phone 60 cm above the floor, portrait, side on. (Smith's default is the phone on the floor.)
tests.cue: Back to the wall, feet about a foot away, slight knee bend, tuck the pelvis so the low back touches. Lift the arms overhead until the low back would leave the wall. (Not one of the measured items in note 150; optional.)

measures.label: Wall flexion angle

points: a point straight below the shoulder (true vertical)

position.caption: Back flat to the wall, arms straight overhead, low back stays on the wall

tests.name: Active shoulder flexion (Test 2, kneeling)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): phone ON THE FLOOR, LANDSCAPE, side on (at 60 cm the phone tilted and skewed the angle). Smith's default is also the floor.
tests.cue: Bent-over kneeling / all fours, pelvis tucked, back ROUNDED (not arched). Lift one arm as high as possible (aim level with the ear), arm straight, back unchanged. Hold 3 s. Each side. Option: hold 1-3 kg to test further.

measures.label: Active flexion angle (arm vs the line along your back)

points: along the back to the hip (the trunk / scapula line)

position.caption: Smith's form: on all fours, back rounded, lift one straight arm

tests.name: Lat length, flat back (Test 3, position 1)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): phone on the floor, PORTRAIT, side on (Smith: side on, phone on the floor).
tests.cue: Stick at shoulder width, palms up. Back to a wall, feet slightly away, knees slightly bent, posterior tilt so the low back presses in. Raise the stick; stop the moment the low back breaks contact. Hold 3 s.

measures.label: Flat back angle

points: a point straight below the shoulder (your back is vertical on the wall)

position.caption: Smith's form: back flat to the support, stick palms up

tests.name: Lat length, rounded back (Test 3, position 2)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): phone on the floor, PORTRAIT, side on (Smith: side on, phone on the floor).
tests.cue: Stick at shoulder width, palms up. Sit on the floor, round as much as possible, head between the knees (chest to knees ideally). Raise the stick keeping head-to-knee contact; contact lost = too far. Hold 3 s. Measure from the bottom tip of the shoulder blade to the shoulder to the elbow (Smith).

measures.label: Rounded back angle

points: bottom tip of the shoulder blade (Smith; the app starts it on the hip, drag it there)

position.caption: Smith's form: rounded, head on the knees, stick palms up

tests.name: Pec major length test, solo (Test 4a)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): lying on a 48 cm bench (piano stool); phone 60 cm above the floor, LANDSCAPE, standing upright and NOT tilted (parallel to you, not leaned against the wall). Smith: camera level with the bench.
tests.cue: Lie on a narrow bench, small plates in each hand (1.25 kg per note 150; 2.5 kg in lesson 144), straight arms, thumbs pointing back the whole time. Lower the arms out to the sides slowly, hands in line with the ears or just above. Torso flat: a small low-back gap must not grow. Hold 3 s.

measures.label: Degrees of the arm past (below) the shoulder line

tests.benchmark: 10 deg (red, poor) to 40 deg (green, good) below the shoulder line (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: lying on a bench, elbows drop below the shoulder line

tests.name: External rotation length test (Test 5, subscapularis + teres major)
tests.camera: From the FRONT, camera in line with the tested elbow and shoulder (elbow directly in front of the shoulder)
tests.cue: Sit on the floor, one knee up, elbow resting on the knee, upper arm at 90 deg to the body, elbow and both shoulders in one line, torso does not rotate. Externally rotate as if pulling back from the wrist. Hold 3 s. Short of vertical = NEGATIVE angle, past vertical = positive (enter the sign).

measures.label: Forearm angle past vertical (0 = straight up, + past it, - short of it)

points: the other shoulder (tells the app which way is outward)

tests.benchmark: -20 deg (red, poor) to 45 deg (green, good) (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: forearm against vertical (45 deg shown)

tests.name: Pec minor test (Test 6, partner, yes/no)
tests.camera: None
tests.cue: Lie on the back, arms slightly out from the sides. Partner gently presses both shoulders toward the floor. Stretch felt once fully pressed = tight pec minor.

measures.label: Stretch felt when pressed

position.caption: Lie on the back, arms slightly out, partner presses both shoulders down to the floor

tests.name: Internal rotation length test (Test 7, infraspinatus + teres minor)
tests.camera: Phone on the floor propped against a wall, side view, shoulders in line with the camera
tests.cue: Lie on the back, arms out so elbows and shoulders form one line, shoulders down, elbows bent 90, forearms up. Let the forearm rotate forward/down keeping 90 deg; shoulder must not lift off the floor; check the elbow has not slipped lower in the frame. Turn around for the other arm. Test gently.

measures.label: Forearm angle from the horizontal floor line on the head side

points: point on the floor line on the head side of the elbow

position.caption: Lie on the back, elbow level with the shoulder and bent 90, forearm up, then let it rotate down without the shoulder lifting

tests.name: Force couple push test (push-up or dip 1-6 rep max)
tests.camera: Film to count reps and check technique
tests.cue: Warm up 5-8 sets, max 5 reps each, rest 1-2 min, harder each set. Rest 5 min, then one set to failure landing in 1-6 reps at tempo 4010. Too easy: lower the push-up hands or add dip weight; failed or >6: rest 8 min, retest. Push-up: feet against a wall, hands by the chest, chest touches the floor/object, testing heights flat/30/60/90 cm only. Dip: only if you can do 1 full bodyweight dip; biceps touch forearms.

measures.label: Test used
Bodyweight
Push-up hand elevation
Dip added weight
Reps achieved (1-6)

tests.camera: None

side_split.name: Side split
side_split.setup: Be honest; never trade position for range; hold statically, no momentum; no specific warm-up. Film from the floor (phone tilted up against an object/wall), good light, plain background, whole body, fitted clothes; record the whole hold. Screenshot the AVERAGE position for the triangle splits and kneeling tilt, the LOWEST point for tailors pose and drop stance. Measure angles in a protractor app (lines through the limb centres, follow the bones, do not overthink); save photos with the videos in a dated folder (e.g. 'Side Split Assessment 01.01.20'). Positioning for every split position: anterior pelvic tilt, sit back as onto a low stool, arched back, legs actively pulled apart (squeeze glutes), feet slightly turned out (between forward and 45 deg), look forward, high chest.

tests.name: Triangle side split, hands supported
tests.camera: Phone on the floor tilted up against an object/wall, good light, plain background, whole body in frame; film front and side; measure from the FRONT
tests.cue: Hands on a chair/stool/blocks, straight arms, feet in line with (or slightly past) the hands, sit back, high chest; shuffle into place. Hold 30 s. Screenshot the AVERAGE hold.

measures.label: Side split angle, hands supported

points: centre point slightly above the hip (lines run along the centre of the thighs across the knees)

position.caption: Hands on a support with straight arms, feet in line with the hands, sit back, chest high

tests.name: Triangle side split, hands free
tests.camera: Phone on the floor tilted up against an object/wall, good light, plain background, whole body in frame; film front and side; measure from the FRONT
tests.cue: From standing slide down; hands off the thighs; widest you can hold 30 s (be conservative; too wide, shorten and retry). Sit back, high chest, arched back, anterior pelvic tilt. Hold 30 s. Screenshot the AVERAGE hold.

measures.label: Side split angle, hands free

points: centre point slightly above the hip (lines run along the centre of the thighs across the knees)

position.caption: Hands off the thighs, sit back, chest high, feet slightly turned out, legs pulled apart

tests.name: Tailors pose
tests.camera: Phone on the floor tilted up against an object/wall, good light, plain background, whole body in frame; film from the FRONT
tests.cue: Back to the wall, soles touching heel to toe, no hands on feet/thighs, pull the knees apart and down by contracting the glutes. Hold 15 s. Screenshot the LOWEST point. If the shins reach the floor, sit on a block with a block of equal height under the feet. Check left vs right.

measures.label: Tailors pose angle (180 deg or more possible with blocks)
Did both calves make full contact with the floor? (phase 1 builder Q2)
Sitting and feet on blocks for this test

position.caption: Back against the wall, soles together, hands off, pull knees apart and down with the glutes

tests.name: Kneeling tilt, open hip
tests.camera: Phone on the floor tilted up against an object/wall, good light, plain background, whole body in frame; film from BEHIND
tests.cue: From all fours bring one leg out to the side, drop to the elbow on the opposite arm, lift the leg as high as possible with the foot in line with or slightly in front of the hip (never behind), squeeze the glutes. Hold 15 s (may cramp). Screenshot the AVERAGE hold.

measures.label: Kneeling tilt angle

points: centre of the heel of the lifting leg (follow the Achilles)
hip joint (where the lines through the centre of each leg meet)
centre of the knee of the supporting leg

position.caption: On the opposite elbow, lift the leg out to the side as high as possible, foot level with or ahead of the hip, squeeze the glutes

tests.name: Drop stance
tests.camera: Phone on the floor tilted up against an object/wall, good light, plain background, whole body in frame; film front and side; measure from the FRONT
tests.cue: Stand wide, feet slightly out, lower over one leg; extended leg's foot flat and facing forward (do not rock onto the heel); chest high; arms forward to counterbalance if needed. Hold 30 s. Screenshot the LOWEST point. Both sides (left/right imbalance check).

measures.label: Drop stance angle (bent leg)

points: centre of the thigh where the femur meets the hip

position.caption: Wide stance, drop over one leg, straight leg foot flat and facing forward, chest high

tests.name: Pancake (deepest width)
tests.camera: Phone on the floor tilted up against an object/wall, good light, plain background, whole body in frame; film from the SIDE
tests.cue: Seated straddle at the width that lets you go deepest (not necessarily widest); reach forward, round the spine, drop the head, contract the hip flexors to pull deeper, feet relaxed. Hold 30 s. If the head reaches the floor record the touchpoint instead of the angle.

measures.label: Pancake angle (head not on the floor)

points: point on the horizontal (seated) line toward the feet
top of the thigh / middle of the trunk
highest point of the upper back (head dropped)

measures.label: Touchpoint reached (phase 1 builder Q3: does your head touch the floor?)

position.caption: Straddle at your deepest width, round the spine, drop the head, actively pull in, feet relaxed

questions.text: Did you hold all assessment positions for the stated time?

questions.text: Are you also training the pancake? (note 93)

front_split.name: Front split
front_split.setup: Cold, no warm-up. Front split = front hip flexion + back hip extension; either can limit. Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips; no partner holding it higher. Square hips throughout. Order: passive front split and isometric front split (both sides), then couch stretch hips low, kneeling lunge and prone knee bend on one leg, repeat on the other leg, then single-leg pike touchpoints and single-leg lift on each side. Measure angles with a protractor app (Angulus on Android, Angle Meter 360 on iOS). Record open or closed hip so measurements stay comparable.

tests.name: Passive front split
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher; back leg faces the camera for both sides
tests.cue: Set up back knee down, slide the front foot forward. Square hips (two lasers on the hip bones shining forward); hip turning out = your limit. Hands on the floor or supports allowed. Hold 30 s; record the AVERAGE depth. Turn round and repeat. Side = front leg.

measures.label: Passive front split angle (Smith's own diagram, front split program builder form)
Hip position used (keep the same for comparable retests)

position.caption: Smith's form: front knee, hip, back knee; hold 30 s

tests.name: Isometric front split
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher
tests.cue: Basically hands free; a wall or object for balance only, not to take weight. Pick a width you can only just hold 30 s. Hold 30 s; record the AVERAGE depth. Side = front leg.

measures.label: Isometric front split angle (Smith's own diagram, front split program builder form)
Stance distance (record to repeat)

position.caption: Smith's form: hands only for balance; hold 30 s

tests.name: Couch stretch, hips low
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher; camera on the back-leg side
tests.cue: Knee padded, knee as close to the wall as possible (note if it cannot touch), foot up the wall; hips low. Hold 15 s. Side = back leg.

measures.label: Couch stretch hips low angle (Smith's own diagram, front split program builder form)
Could the back knee touch the wall?

position.caption: Smith's form: back knee to the wall, hips low; hold 15 s

tests.name: Kneeling lunge
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher; camera on the back-leg side
tests.cue: From the couch stretch shuffle forward, back foot to the floor, hips low. Hold 15 s. Side = back leg.

measures.label: Kneeling lunge angle (Smith's own diagram, front split program builder form)

position.caption: Smith's form: back foot on the floor, hips low; hold 15 s

tests.name: Prone active hip extension
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher
tests.cue: Lie face down, bend the knee, lift the foot as high as possible, foot roughly over the knee. Hold 15 s. Then repeat couch stretch, kneeling lunge and this on the other leg (move the camera).

measures.label: Prone active hip extension angle (Smith's own diagram, front split program builder form)

points: knee of the leg on the floor

position.caption: Smith's form: face down, lift the thigh; hold 15 s

tests.name: Single-leg standing pike, touchpoints
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher
tests.cue: Front leg straight, foot dorsiflexed (big toe pulled back if possible), back leg bent or straight; hinge, lifting the rib cage over and down. Touch with the OPPOSITE hand across the body. Elbow ladder first, then head ladder. Cannot reach shaka: measure with a stick or table leg (hair tie marker). Hold 15 s. Side = front leg.

measures.label: Elbow/head to toe touchpoint (21-step ladder)
If you cannot reach shaka: stick/table-leg marker distance

position.caption: Smith's form: fold over the straight front leg; hold 15 s

tests.name: Single-leg lift (active hip flexion)
tests.camera: Phone ALWAYS on the floor, same orientation, camera perpendicular to the hips (looking at the centre of the body); no partner holding it higher
tests.cue: Straighten the standing leg, both legs straight, lift the leg forward and hold 15 s. Repeat single-leg pike and lift on the other side. Side = lifted leg.

measures.label: Single-leg lift angle (Smith's own diagram, front split program builder form)

position.caption: Smith's form: straight leg lifted forward; hold 15 s

questions.text: Do you have approval from a healthcare provider to train front splits?

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.setup: Minimal warm-up. Phone on the floor, same way every time, for every test except the pec major test (camera at bench height). Screenshot left and right and add angles. The bridge program builder (179) needs tests 1-5: external rotation, pec major, couch stretch hips low, kneeling lunge, bridge level. The Leahy stick test is the separate 'am I ready' check (171): limited shoulder flexion is a very common bridge limiter; if so, train shoulders first. Shoulder ER and pec major are the same tests as the shoulder flexion pillar.

tests.name: Leahy stick test (bridge readiness, as lesson 141)
tests.camera: Phone on the floor, tilted slightly up, from the side
tests.cue: Sit on a box, upright, high chest, look forward. Hold a stick at its CENTRE, palm up, in one hand. Arm locked, lift; the stick stays parallel to the floor. Elbow bends or stick twists = too far, lower and lift again. Hold 3 s. Both sides. Bridge use (171): the course page reads this result to advise direct bridge work or shoulders first.

measures.label: Leahy flexion angle (vertical up = 180)

points: a point straight below the shoulder (true vertical, Smith's plumb line)

position.caption: Smith's form: arm against the line straight down from the shoulder

tests.name: Shoulder external rotation length test (bridge test 1, as lesson 146)
tests.camera: From the FRONT, camera aligned with the tested arm (elbow directly in front of the shoulder from the camera view)
tests.cue: Seated on the floor, knee up, elbow on the knee, upper arm at a right angle to the body, elbow and both shoulders in one line. Rotate out to the limit as if pulling back from the wrist, hold a few seconds. Most common error: torso rotated so the elbow is not in front of the shoulder. Both sides. Short of vertical = NEGATIVE angle.

measures.label: Forearm angle past vertical (0 = straight up, + past it, - short of it)

points: the other shoulder (tells the app which way is outward)

tests.benchmark: -20 deg (red, poor) to 45 deg (green, good) (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: -20 deg poor, 45 deg good

tests.name: Pec major length test (bridge test 2, as lesson 144)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): lying on a 48 cm bench (piano stool); phone 60 cm above the floor, LANDSCAPE, standing upright and NOT tilted (parallel to you, not leaned against the wall). Smith: camera level with the bench.
tests.cue: Narrow bench or boxes; 1.25-1.5 kg plates. Arms up, thumbs back, lower thumbs-first towards the floor; hold max depth 3 s. Torso flat (feet on the bench helps); wrists in line with the ears. Plates hit the floor -> grip higher -> then elevate the setup.

measures.label: Degrees of the arm past (below) the shoulder line

tests.benchmark: 10 deg (red, poor) to 40 deg (green, good) below the shoulder line (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: 10 deg poor, 40 deg good below the shoulder line

tests.name: Couch stretch, hips high
tests.camera: Phone on the floor, same way every time, on the back-leg side
tests.cue: Hips HIGH (torso upright, hips over the back knee), per Smith's bridge builder form. Back knee padded, as close to the wall as possible, foot up the wall, hips low, torso upright. Hold 10 s. Both legs.

measures.label: Hip angle between the thighs (acute inside angle)

tests.benchmark: 90 deg (red, poor), 150 deg (example), 190 deg (green, good) (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: hips HIGH, torso upright; 90 poor, 190 good

tests.name: Kneeling lunge (bridge test 4)
tests.camera: Phone on the floor, same way every time, side on
tests.cue: From the couch stretch shuffle forward, back foot to the floor, hips low. Hold 10 s. Both legs.

measures.label: Hip angle between the thighs (acute inside angle)

tests.benchmark: 90 deg (red, poor), 154 deg (example), 190 deg (green, good) (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: 90 poor, 190 good

tests.name: Bridge (bridge test 5)
tests.camera: Phone on the floor perpendicular to the shoulders; tight clothes or top tucked in
tests.cue: Lie down, feet near the hips, hands by the head with fingers to the feet, hands about shoulder width (slightly wider only if the shoulders need it). Push up and walk the feet in. Cannot push up -> double hip drive (lift the hips, roll onto the head, adjust hands and feet, push up with momentum). Bring the shoulders and chest over the hands as much as possible; hold 15 s (or the highest position you can, e.g. head supported). Pick the category.

measures.label: Bridge level

position.caption: Smith's form: can't lift / behind hands / above hands / past hands

questions.name: Healthcare approval
questions.text: Do you have approval from your healthcare provider to train this skill?

shoulder_extension.name: Shoulder extension
shoulder_extension.setup: OURS: Smith has no shoulder extension module or test. Two checks the notes support: the pec major length test (144; 137: arm back behind the body isolates pec major; his free-video summary names it the nearest test) and the stick dislocate grip width (159, tracked with tape marks or cm between the hands). Same stick every time.

tests.name: Pec major length test (as lesson 144)
tests.camera: Your set-up (14 Nov 2026): lying on a 48 cm bench (piano stool); phone 60 cm above the floor, LANDSCAPE, standing upright and NOT tilted (parallel to you, not leaned against the wall). Smith: camera level with the bench.
tests.cue: Lie on a narrow bench, small plates in each hand (1.25-2.5 kg across the notes), straight arms, thumbs pointing back the whole time. Lower the arms out to the sides slowly, hands in line with the ears or just above. Torso flat: a small low-back gap must not grow. Hold 3 s.

measures.label: Degrees of the arm past (below) the shoulder line

tests.benchmark: 10 deg (red, poor) to 40 deg (green, good) below the shoulder line (Smith's builder form diagram)

position.caption: Smith's form: lying on a bench, elbows drop below the shoulder line

tests.name: Stick dislocate grip width (ours, from lesson 159)
tests.camera: None needed (measure the stick)
tests.cue: Same stick every time, tape marks on it. Take the stick over the head and behind with straight elbows, rolling the shoulders forward as the arms go back (inlocate) and back on the return (dislocate). Find the narrowest grip with straight elbows, no hands sliding and both shoulders moving evenly. Record the distance between the hands.

measures.label: Grip width between the hands (narrower = more range)
Grip used

position.caption: Stick held in front, wide even grip, straight elbows; mark hand positions on the stick

squat.name: Squat
squat.setup: OURS: Smith has no squat module. Checks the notes support: drop stance angle each side (94, left/right check), horse stance step width and hips vs knee line (106-107), hip internal rotation (56: carries over to a deeper squat; test as lesson 32). Phone on the floor, same spot every time, except hip IR (camera at box height).

tests.name: Drop stance (Pu Bu) angle
tests.camera: Phone on the floor, facing you, whole body in frame, same spot every time
tests.cue: Wide straddle, feet slightly turned out, drop onto one leg, straight-leg foot flat and forward (not rolled up). Sit as low as you can. Hold time not stated in the notes. Both sides.

measures.label: Knee angle of the bent leg (acute inside angle)

position.caption: Wide stance, drop over one leg, straight leg foot flat and facing forward, chest high

tests.name: Horse stance squat width and depth
tests.camera: Phone on the floor, facing you, whole body in frame
tests.cue: Count steps from feet together: each turn of a foot = 1 step (toes out, heels out, alternating), then toes to your turnout. Typical start = 5 steps. Squat with knees out, feet turned out, sit back, spine extended, chest high. Note where the hips sit vs the knee line at the bottom.

measures.label: Step width (number of steps)
Hips at the bottom

position.caption: Feet turned out, knees pushed out over the feet, weight at the chest, hips sink to knee level, chest high

tests.name: Hip internal rotation length test (as lesson 32)
tests.camera: Camera at BOX HEIGHT, level with the box seat, facing you from the front
tests.cue: Sit on a flat object, knees just over the edge, feet off the floor. Block or clasped hands between the knees, press the knees slightly together, sit upright, pull the feet out hard, knees stay at 90 deg.

measures.label: Rotation (shin vs vertical, acute inside angle)

position.caption: Smith's form: on a box, knees together, feet swing out
